title: Regal Rexnord Aerospace Solutions Announces AS9100 Certification for Chihuahua, MX Plant
body_text: Regal Rexnord Aerospace Solutions Announces AS9100 Certification for Chihuahua, MX Plant Regal Rexnord Aerospace Solutions is proud to announce that our Chihuahua, Mexico facility achieved AS9100 certification on January 30, 2025. This accomplishment represents a significant milestone for the Aerospace Solutions team, demonstrating our unwavering commitment to delivering exceptional quality and reliable products to the aerospace industry. To earn this crucial certification, a third-party assessment was conducted by the Performance Review Institute (PRI). Their thorough audit examined the Quality Management System (QMS) processes at our Chihuahua plant, including Raw Material Receiving, Saw, Machining, Shipping, Purchase Order Review, Purchasing, and the Manufacturing of Bearings. What Does This Mean for Our Customers? The AS9100 certification serves as a hallmark of trust within the aerospace industry. Customers can confidently rely on Regal Rexnord to consistently deliver high-quality parts with the added benefits of expanded capabilities and increased production capacity. This achievement further strengthens our ability to meet First Time Quality and On-Time Delivery commitments. Benefits for Regal Rexnord & Aerospace Solutions Group: The certification amplifies our growth strategy by enhancing capacity, facilitating cross-plant collaboration, and enabling division-level workload balancing. With this new capability, we are better positioned to address backorders and produce even more products to meet growing demand. Driving Innovation for the Future: The combination of our new plant and its AS9100 certification reinforces Regal Rexnord’s role as a trusted partner in aerospace component manufacturing. This milestone builds confidence with our customers, ensuring that we remain their preferred choice for high-quality, reliable components. We extend our gratitude to everyone who contributed to this achievement, and we look forward to continuing to exceed expectations as we deliver excellence in every part we produce!

title: Thin Laminates as Embedded Capacitance for PDN Designs | Qnity Electronics(formerly DuPont Electronics)
summary: Power distribution networks provide clean power for electronics. Using thin laminates for capacitance enables lighter end products with low signal noise
body_text: Power-distribution applications in telecom and networking industry demand ever-denser IC designs, smaller chip geometries and higher device speeds, boosting the current drawn by the microprocessor from the PDN. The increase in power dissipation places rigorous demands on noise reduction, indicating many more decoupling capacitors must to be added to the PDN to reduce the source of noise. However, it causes routing problems and changes the predicted performance of a capacitor because of the increased inductance. Use of thin and very thin copper-clad laminates as embedded capacitance (i.e., a pair of power/ground layer pairs) is an approach that eliminates many decoupling capacitors from the board – not because of the increased capacitance of the thin laminate, but rather due to its lower inductance [3]. The impedance plot in Figure 2 shows impedance magnitude of a square pair of planes with various dielectric thicknesses. With 0.25mm (10-mil, 250µm) plane separation, the impedance swings are substantial at the resonance frequencies, and as thinness goes to 25µm or below, we see a significant reduction. The PDN impedance is approximately proportional to the laminate thickness. As the laminate gets thinner, suppression of modal resonances can be achieved.

(NYSE: STNG) (“Scorpio Tankers,” or the “Company”) announced today that on Thursday, July 30, 2026, the Company plans to issue its second quarter 2026 earnings press release in the morning (Eastern Daylight Time) and host a conference call at 8:00 AM Eastern Daylight Time and 2:00 PM Central European Summer Time. About Scorpio Tankers Inc. Scorpio Tankers Inc. is a provider of marine transportation of petroleum products worldwide. Scorpio Tankers Inc. currently owns 74 product tankers (25 LR2 tankers, 35 MR tankers and 14 Handymax tankers) with an average age of 10.1 years. The Company has reached agreements or letters of intent for six MR newbuildings that are currently under construction with deliveries expected in 2026, 2027 and 2030, four LR2 newbuildings with deliveries expected in 2027 and 2029 and two VLCC newbuildings with deliveries expected in 2028.
